name: Alley Kingz
description: Alley Kingz is the 48-card Solana battle collection behind $BCARDD. Cyberpunk dog crews pilot Twisted-Metal street war-rigs down Clash-Royale lanes -- one dog, one currency, one aesthetic, one arcade. Each card is a playable Metaplex Core asset: the NFT IS the card, with gameplay stats (HP, damage, ability) written on-chain via the Core Attribute Plugin and read by the Everlight Arcade game and the marketplace alike. $BCARDD (card #0001) is the $BCARDD coin mascot and the blackjack dealer -- the through-line that ties the coin, the cards, and the arcade to the same dog and the same vanta-black-and-gold color story. In-game items and tokens are for entertainment and utility, not investments. No promised returns. $BCARDD is a community meme coin inspired by $BCARDD the dog; not affiliated with $BCARDD Limited.

properties.standard_note: Metaplex Core Collection (single on-chain account per asset). Confirmed live 2026-06-03: mpl-core 1.10.0, umi 1.5.1.

_operator_notes.royalty_plugin: Set the Core Royalties plugin on the collection at create time. Per ECOSYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE section 4.4: 2.5% royalty (250 bps) to treasury + 2.5% marketplace fee burned. Royalty basisPoints = 250, creator = treasury wallet.
_operator_notes.update_authority: Per CHAIN_DECISION_MEMO open item 2: update authority should be a treasury multisig/PDA the game controls, NOT a single hot key, so stat balance-patches are possible but no one key can rewrite every card. Operator decides who holds it before mint.
_operator_notes.image_gated_on_art: Collection image is a placeholder CID until the collection key-art lands. Swap <COLLECTION_IMAGE_CID> after upload (see upload_assets.md).
